propositions: binding_lifecycle.py contains two legacy config-ownership exceptions (RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE read via _env_int shim and raw os.environ.get) that are the last two rows in the LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS whitelist

A owned accessor resolve_absent_retire_grace() already exists and is publicly exposed via rebar.config facade with identical semantics (env var over default 3, clamped >= 1), following the established pattern used by fetcher.py and applier.py
The _env_int helper in binding_lifecycle.py is dead code once its single caller (note_absent grace read) is replaced with the public facade accessor
Removing both exceptions from LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS will reach EMPTY state and complete the RP-04 config-ownership drain
The _DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE constant must be retained because it is aliased by binding_store.py and consumed by resurrection tests, despite being a plain non-ambient constant
